description: Use this when the user wants baby name ideas or lists filtered by sex, first letter, ending, letters contained, length, syllables, 2025 popularity (e.g. "familiar but not common" = rank 201-1000), rising names, vintage names (popular 1910-1930, rare now), names popular in an era, or unisex names (40-60% girls). Returns matching names with 2025 rank, births and trend from US Social Security data. Does not give meanings, origins, religious or astrological criteria; do not use for non-US popularity.

contains.description: Name contains these letters anywhere, e.g. "rose".

ends_with.description: Name ends with these letters, e.g. "lyn".

era_from.description: Era start year for 'popular back then', e.g. 1950.

era_max_rank.description: Rank a name must have reached in some era year, e.g. 100. Default 300.

limit.description: How many names to return, 1-60, e.g. 30 (default).

min_births_2025.description: Minimum US births in 2025, e.g. 100. Default 50 when rising_years is set, else 0.

popularity.description: 2025 rank band: top_100 (1-100), common (101-200), familiar (201-1000, familiar but not common), uncommon (1001-5000), rare (5001 or lower). Example: familiar.

rank_max.description: Highest 2025 rank number to include, e.g. 1000.

rank_min.description: Lowest 2025 rank number to include, e.g. 200.

rising_years.description: Only names with more births in 2025 than N years earlier, sorted by growth, e.g. 10 (compares 2015 to 2025).

sex.description: girl, boy or any (default any: girls and boys listed separately), e.g. girl.

sort.description: Order: popular (most 2025 births), rising (biggest growth), alphabetical, rarest (fewest 2025 births). Default popular, or rising with rising_years.

starts_with.description: Name begins with these letters, case-insensitive, e.g. "a" or "el".

unisex.description: true = names where girls are 40-60% of 2016-2025 US births (at least 100 births in that period). Example: true.

vintage.description: true = vintage names: top 300 in some year 1910-1930 and outside the 2025 top 1,000. Example: true.

name: find_baby_names
title: Find baby names
